name: Liedy's Shore Inn
closed_reason: Family bar founded in 1905 by Jacob Liedy closed after 119 years when the owner retired; its state liquor license is listed as inactive, having expired April 30, 2025.

name: Schaller's (Brighton)
closed_reason: The Brighton branch (opened 1996, per Schaller's) is listed as inactive in NYSDOH records, with its last inspection in January 2024. Another restaurant holds the food-service permit at the address and was inspected in January 2026. The Greece and Irondequoit Schaller's stay open.
